title: Register 'rocket loop' command in Commander
description: Add the 'loop' subcommand to the Commander program with flags for selecting the AI backend. The default backend is Copilot CLI, with optional --claude and --docker flags to switch backends.
acceptanceCriteria: --claude flag is registered with a description
--docker flag is registered with a description
Command is wired to src/commands/loop.ts handler
rocket loop --help shows --claude and --docker flags with descriptions

steps.details: Create src/commands/loop.ts exporting: `export async function loopCommand(options: { claude?: boolean; docker?: boolean }): Promise<void> { console.log('loop command', options) }`

steps.description: Register the loop command in src/cli.ts
steps.details: Add to program in src/cli.ts: `program.command('loop').description('Run the AI development loop').option('--claude', 'Use Claude CLI as the AI backend (direct, no docker)').option('--docker', 'Use Claude in a Docker sandbox as the AI backend').action(loopCommand)`
Add import: `import { loopCommand } from './commands/loop.js'` at top of src/cli.ts.
Run `npm run dev -- loop --help`. Should show both --claude and --docker flags with their descriptions.

technicalNotes: Commander's option() method with boolean flags (no argument) stores true/false in the options object
The loop command will later also receive --max-iterations flag (TASK-18) and --no-caffeinate flag (TASK-106)
